item.title: Doorstop interview - Sydney
item.content: ANTHONY ALBANESE, PRIME MINISTER: John Olsen deserved a wonderful send off and he received that today at the Art Gallery of New South Wales. John Olsen's passing leaves a space, but he has filled it with light and colour, as bright as that twinkle that he had in his eye. He imagined a landscape and showed it for all Australians, but indeed, to showcase it to the world. And his legacy will live on.
